title: Sagittarius, the right one asks for the window seat
caption: for the sagittarians with a bag already packed

scenes.text: you were born with one foot out the door.
jupiter made you big, curious, impossible to hold.
every map you own has a corner folded down.
and when love goes quiet, you start packing.
because still water makes the fire in you restless.
but here's what the road never told you.
some people don't want to keep you.
they want to see where you're going.
so say the honest thing: you need the horizon.
the right one won't hold the door. they'll ask for the window seat.
the sky is wide enough for two of you.
